extracted.name: Mimi's Butter Cookies
extracted.description: Great recipe for Mimi's Butter Cookies.
ingredient_lines: Strawberry jam for decorating or chocolate just melt in the microwave
instruction_lines: Add "all-purpose flour" and continue mixing until well combined
Put the dough into piping bag and pipe as design
Store in the fridge for 5-10 minutes so they stay in the shape you desire
Bake at 160C for 12-15 minutes depends on your liking for me I like them a little brown
Let them cool on a rack for about 5 minutes before serving or bagging them
Extra step: add strawberry jam in to give it some color
